# Ashanti's Kitchenware

Ashanti's Kitchenware is a kitchen appliance shop in Accra, Ghana. Prices on the site are in Ghana Cedis.

- Website: https://ashantiskitchenware.com
- Address: 108 Dansoman-Sakaman, Alui Mahama Street, Blue Lagoon Loop, Accra, Greater Accra, Ghana
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Closed Sunday.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +233 20 194 4235
- Email: ashantiskitchenware@gmail.com
- Collection: at the shop
- Delivery: the shop confirms the charge and timing on WhatsApp after the order. Checkout does not add a delivery fee.
- Returns: faulty, damaged, or incorrect items can be requested within 7 days of delivery
